name: Companion Cache (Bonded)
body:
You use your mystical companion as a reservoir for your spells.

Prerequisite: Bonded creature

Benefit: You can store a number of spell levels within your animal companion, familiar, or mount equal to your character level. For example, at 3rd level you could store one 1st-level spell and one 2nd-level spell or six 0-level spells. In all other ways this acts as a ring of spell storing.
